sentences: A Woman of the Sea, also known by its working title Sea Gulls, is an unreleased silent film produced in 1926 by the Chaplin Film Company.
It is one of only two lost Charlie Chaplin films (the other being " Her Friend the Bandit"), having been destroyed by Chaplin himself as a tax writeoff.
The now lost film starred Edna Purviance, Raymond Bloomer, Eve Southern and Charles French, and was directed by Josef von Sternberg.
